units.source_text: 这些情景，不能说我都看到了，但这一切我都清清楚楚地感觉到了。

en.t: I cannot say that I saw all of these scenes, but I felt every one of them with perfect clarity.

units.source_text: 呈现在我眼前的，仿佛是温馨的白乳汁喷在黑色茶碗内侧的冒泡的绿茶中，

en.t: What appeared before my eyes was as though warm white milk had been sprayed into the foaming green tea inside a black tea bowl,

units.source_text: 仿佛看见已经济完而残留着奶滴的情形，

en.t: as though I could see the state after it had already been poured, with drops of milk still remaining,

units.source_text: 白乳汁弄混浊了寂静的茶水而起泡沫的情形……

en.t: the sight of the white milk clouding the still tea and making it foam...
